name: Rough Crossbeam
description: Cuts with both hands in a controlled arc that keeps the blade's balance at the end of the swing

name: Lugs Flog
description: Pivots on the front foot and chops across the body so the hips lead the blade

name: Unmoving Heft
description: Raises the hilt high and tilts the blade forward so a falling cut slides off the edge

name: Prowling Greatedge
description: Takes a long pace forward with the blade low so the cut can rise at the end of the step

name: Longgrip Barrier
description: Catches the opponent's blade in the crossguard and twists to wrench it from line

name: Stern Bulk
description: Rides the momentum of a full swing with a pulse of qi so the cleave lands with doubled weight

name: Bold Counterweight
description: Chops as the lead foot lands and sends qi from the ground through the blade

name: Harsh Greatsweep
description: Drives a cut from the legs through the hips and arms so the entire body lands behind the edge

name: Buttressed Flange
description: Sinks the stance after a heavy blow so the recoil runs into the ground and not the wrists

name: Hiltwrap Flog
description: Chops from outside the opponent's guard onto their near shoulder or arm

name: Rondel Stalk
description: Shuffles forward behind a braced guard so the blade covers the approach

name: Swift Windmill
description: Gathers qi into the blade at the top of the swing so the downstroke breaks a raised guard

name: Greatedge Screen
description: Holds the flat against a heavy blow with qi bracing the arms so the guard does not give

name: Bulkscorer
description: Sets the edge at a shallow slant to the target so it bites deeper into the cut

name: Brisk Mulinet
description: Lets the blade's own weight swing it up and over into a chop without arm strain

name: Dire Haul
description: Throws the pommel behind the body to counterweight the blade and speed the turn of the cut

name: Heft Screen
description: Beats the opponent's blade aside with the flat to clear the line for a thrust

name: Hefthurdle
description: Steps half a pace back while the blade drops to cover the front

name: Sure Flange
description: Judges how much weight the opponent's blade carries and which parries it will not survive

name: Hungry Overswing
description: Draws qi along the edge as the blade is pulled through the target so it slices cleanly

name: Haulflog
description: Pours qi into the blade's weight at the instant of the fall and drops it with crushing force

name: Brawn Windmill
description: Hews straight down as in the first drill but with a controlled stop at the low guard

name: Clay Counterweight
description: Hews from one shoulder to the opposite hip and returns without a pause

name: Draught Rondel
description: Wards off a strike with a quick angled parry that leaves the blade ready to counter

name: Gritbulk
description: Glides one pace in any direction without lifting the heels or raising the blade

name: Static Crossbeam
description: Hooks the opponent's weapon with the crossguard and pulls it off its line

name: Clay Longgrip
description: Holds the blade across the body and braces the stance against a pushing blow

name: Dire Hiltwrap
description: Links three qi-backed hews from alternating shoulders into one unbroken flurry

name: Haze Rondel
description: Turns a parry into a cleave in one motion with qi hardening the blade at contact

name: Rigid Crossbeam
description: Moves forward behind a line of sweeping guards so the blade covers every approach

name: Greatsweep Thwack
description: Carries the end of one cut straight into the start of the next with no pause

name: Stubborn Bulk
description: Catches an overswung blade at the low guard before the opponent can take the opening

name: Heftslap
description: Whips the blade back along its own arc behind the body and cuts again from the rear

name: Ducking Haul
description: Takes a single pace after a cut to bring the feet back under the body

name: Kindly Lugs
description: Reads the start of the opponent's swing to find the instant when it cannot be stopped

name: Harsh Overswing
description: Turns a full body whirl with qi spun out along the blade to cut every side in a ring

name: Wrenchhurdle
description: Slides back into the guard right after a cut with qi tightening the arms

name: Wild Hiltwrap
description: Cuts downward in time with a full breath of qi circulation through the arms

name: Lugsslap
description: Rises from a low guard in a cut timed to the in-breath of qi circulation

name: Raw Heft
description: Crosses the body in a cut timed so qi reaches the edge at the moment of contact

name: Flange Hasp
description: Drops the blade in front of the body and turns a strike off the edge with a breath of qi

name: Slinking Lugs
description: Strides in time with breath so steps and cuts rise and fall together

name: Haul Screen
description: Hooks and hauls the opponent's weapon with qi tightening the grip

name: Rugged Mulinet
description: Thrusts the point at the throat or chest with qi reaching the tip as the arms lock

name: Savage Greatsweep
description: Chains cuts to breaths so that each cut lands on the out-breath of qi

name: Lugsprop
description: Chains parries to breaths so each guard hardens on the in-breath of qi

name: Rushing Wrench
description: Pushes qi to the tip of the thrust so that it pierces a layer of leather or light mail

name: Honedhaul
description: Cuts in so the blades cross at the strong part of the edge and the bind begins

name: Gall Bulk
description: Presses down on the crossed blades to hold the opponent's weapon from lifting

name: Claybulk
description: Steps out of a bind to the side as the opponent's pressure falls through empty space

name: Flangeprop
description: Shoves the crossguard against the opponent's hands to break the bind and open the line

name: Levering Windmill
description: Sends qi down the crossed blades to lock the opponent's weapon in place for a moment

name: Emberwrench
description: Releases the bind with a sudden qi flick that throws the opponent's blade aside and cuts

name: Ruthless Counterweight
description: Sweeps with the whole blade extended so the point reaches the farthest target

name: Haulscorer
description: Whips the last hand's width of the blade across the target with a quick wrist flick

name: Bulkswat
description: Thrusts long to meet an advancing opponent and stop them at the end of the blade

name: Longgrip Buckle
description: Parries with the blade's far end where leverage is greatest and the opponent's cut is weakest

name: Pirouetting Overswing
description: Backs away a long pace to bring a threatening opponent into the blade's best reach

name: Patient Greatedge
description: Gauges the gap between the point and the opponent so each cut lands at its full reach

name: Rugged Crossbeam
description: Carries qi out to the blade's tip so the sweep strikes harder at its extreme end

name: Rondelthwack
description: Lunges a full pace beyond the blade's length with qi driving the point through the guard

name: Honedflange
description: Opens an exchange with a broad sweep that forces the opponent back a step

name: Greatsweep Swat
description: Closes a retreating opponent with a long thrust that stops short of overreaching

name: Rondel Buckle
description: Uses the returning arc of a sweep as a parry against a counterstrike

name: Draught Wrench
description: Pulls the blade and body back after a thrust to a safe distance

name: Humlugs
description: Presses forward with the crossguard raised to close the gap and crowd the opponent's arms

name: Shardbulk
description: Holds the blade at the end of a sweep to cover the flank that the swing exposed

name: Crimson Wrench
description: Turns the end of a sweep into a thrust in one motion with qi rushing to the point

name: Draught Flange
description: Turns a missed thrust into a sweeping cut across the opponent's evasion

name: Regimen Haul
description: Sweeps a wide ring of qi-hardened steel that forces every nearby opponent to give ground

name: Heftprop
description: Uses the long hilt as a lever to hold a guard against heavier blows

name: Lassoing Hiltwrap
description: Hooks the opponent's arm with the hilt and levers it aside to open the line

name: Flangeflog
description: Levers the blade up against the opponent's guard to open it with a cut from below

name: Fleet Mulinet
description: Backs away behind a levered guard so the blade covers each step

name: Lugsscorer
description: Swings the pommel in a short hard arc against the opponent's head or hands

name: Bulkhasp
description: Braces a guard with qi down the hilt so even a heavy blow cannot lever it open

name: Wrenchscreen
description: Hooks the opponent's arm and throws qi into the lever to pull them off their feet
